pyq_bad.why: garbled: budget table merged into A-R stem
wrong topic: functions of public sector
wrong options: truncated, keyed option reads as total revenue minus expenditure

patterns: APPSC asks direct definitions: FD = total expenditure minus receipts excluding borrowing; PD = FD minus interest; RD = revenue exp minus revenue receipts; budget deficit + borrowings = FD.
Relations/traps: 'PD always higher than FD' (false), zero PD means borrowing equals interest, FD always > RD; descending order FD > RD > PD.
Objective vs tool traps: interest rates/CRR/money supply are monetary, not fiscal; Musgrave allocation/distribution (progressive taxation) functions.
Year-specific FD figures (BE/RE % of GDP) are asked frequently by PSCs, including APPSC current-year statement pairs (2024-25 RE 4.8%).
App MCQs match these shapes well; a few add AP-state budget data and opinion/critique statements not seen in PYQs.
